ports.name: candidateOverflow
ports.doc: One when refinement may be incomplete because an intermediate capacity was too small.

ports.name: uncertainCount
ports.doc: Exact number of classifications resolved through the documented uncertainty fallback.

ports.name: unresolvedCount
ports.doc: Number of classifications or work items still unresolved after the stage's available work.

ports.name: complete
ports.doc: One when the entire promised result is present, accounting for all supplied loss evidence; zero otherwise. In `GPURecipeStageStatusPort.status`, certifies only the stage named by `stage`, not the aggregate recipe. The producer documents the exact result being certified. Omission provides no certificate and must not be interpreted as completeness.

ports.name: antimeridianUncertainCount
ports.doc: Rings with an edge whose raw longitude step exceeds 180 (antimeridian crossing, not split).

ports.name: poleUncertainCount
ports.doc: Rings whose wrapped longitude steps sum to +-360 (enclose a pole, not capped).

ports.name: invalidCount
ports.doc: Number of input rows rejected by validation or, for `GPURasterFillNoData`, the number of cells of the result that are still invalid after the fill.

ports.name: iterationCount
ports.doc: Number of iterations, rounds or passes actually executed.

ports.name: converged
ports.doc: One when the operation met its stopping condition.

ports.name: iterationLimitReached
ports.doc: One when the iteration budget was exhausted before convergence.

ports.name: approximation
ports.doc: One when the result uses an intentional approximation rather than exact semantics.

ports.name: vertexCount
ports.doc: Number of vertices written, clamped to the vertex capacity.

ports.name: requiredVertexCount
ports.doc: Unclamped number of vertices the result needs.

ports.name: ringCount
ports.doc: Number of rings written, clamped to the ring capacity.

ports.name: requiredRingCount
ports.doc: Unclamped number of rings the result needs.

ports.name: code
ports.doc: Optional one-row result code of a stage whose contributor reports a code rather than row counts (for example a solver's `status.code`): 0 on success, otherwise the contributor's documented failure code. Test it against 0; it is not a count and must not be summed.

ports.name: count
ports.doc: Number of usable rows or elements written.

ports.name: requiredCount
ports.doc: Unclamped requirement at the producer's final stage, before final-output truncation. A lower bound on the full requirement when candidates were lost; scan totals saturate at `0xffffffff`. Exact only when neither candidate loss nor saturation occurred.

ports.name: overflow
ports.doc: One when the final result is incomplete because its output capacity was too small.
